answer: Joining requires one glass prism kept in a velvet case at a library. To claim a reward, the holder visits once, shines light through it, and photographs the spectrum on a velvet board; no two prisms throw the same spectrum, each glass fractured differently. Two falcon-eyed verifiers compare the photo with the registered spectrum within 24 hours. A copied spectrum or a reused prism locks the account and burns its deposit. One honest person needs one prism and one visit, but a thousand fakes would need a thousand unique prisms and a thousand visits.
